implied_expectations.interpretation: The price still embeds durable low-to-mid-teens cash-flow growth for a long period. That is plausible for Intuitive but leaves limited room for execution error.

bear.description: Procedure growth decelerates toward high single digits, competitors gain share, leasing/capex intensity rises and the valuation normalizes.

base.description: Da Vinci remains the category leader, global procedure growth stays in the low-to-mid teens for several years, da Vinci 5/SP/Ion expand the ecosystem and margins remain structurally high.

bull.description: OUS adoption accelerates, da Vinci 5 and SP expand indications rapidly, Ion becomes a major second platform, and operating leverage sustains mid-teens FCF growth.

permanent_loss_case.description: A credible permanent-loss path is not insolvency but a combination of clinically credible competing platforms, hospital multi-vendor adoption, regulatory/antitrust constraints on instruments/service economics, slower procedure growth and a lasting valuation multiple reset.
signposts: Sustained da Vinci procedure growth below 10%
Recurring revenue share or I&A revenue per procedure structurally declines
Competitive losses spread beyond China into core U.S./European accounts
Material product-safety event or regulatory restriction
FCF per share stagnates despite continued high reinvestment

notes: Reference price is the Intuitive investor-relations closing price for 2026-09-03. LTM simple FCF proxy = operating cash flow less cash purchases of PP&E; it is not a company-defined metric and does not fully capture the economics of operating-lease system transfers, inventory build, or share-based compensation.
